title: Clawd X Digest
summary: World Cup Drama: Germany and the Netherlands are knocked out of the 2026 World Cup within hours, sparking intense controversy over Leon Goretzka's refusal to take a penalty against Paraguay and celebrating Bono's spectacular save for Morocco.

AI & E-Ink Hardware: Developers are running Claude Code on the reMarkable Paper Pro e-ink tablet, finding that slower screen refresh rates naturally align with the pacing of AI token generation to create a distraction-free coding setup.
Regulatory Arbitrage: Midea's clever design of air conditioners containing exactly 1.99kg of coolant allows it to bypass strict French inspection rules (>2kg) and Italian DIY installation fines.
Predictive Market Automation: Crypto traders are leveraging CodeX agents on Polymarket-integrated platforms like Predict.fun to automate sports betting and run script-driven arbitrage.
AI Agent Data Bridges: Exa Labs launches Exa Connect, enabling AI agents to search structured enterprise databases like ZoomInfo and Crunchbase beyond the open web.

items.title: @elonmusk: Cybercab Driving in Austin
items.body: Elon Musk shared video footage of the steering-wheel-free, pedal-free Cybercab driving autonomously around Austin, Texas, showcasing Tesla's driverless vision in action.

items.title: @browomo: Claude Code on E-Ink Tablet
items.body: A developer successfully ran Claude Code on the reMarkable Paper Pro e-ink tablet over SSH. The slow screen refresh rate of e-ink aligns perfectly with the model's word-by-word token generation pace, offering an eye-friendly, distraction-free environment with days of battery life.

items.title: @cline: GLM-5.2 and Subscription Model
items.body: Cline introduced support for GLM-5.2 alongside a $9.99/month subscription program providing discounted access to open-weight models like DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax, and Qwen.

items.title: @opencode: GLM 5.2 Cost-to-Utility Ratio
items.body: Developers are noting that GLM 5.2 has a high cost-per-session footprint, but is drawing rave reviews because session cost correlates with actual agent utility.

items.title: @ExaAILabs: Exa Connect Launch
items.body: Exa announced Exa Connect, linking AI agents directly to high-value structured data providers (such as ZoomInfo, Crunchbase, and Similarweb) instead of relying solely on public web scraping.

items.title: @ZhanweiC: Automated Prediction Market Arbitrage
items.body: Traders are discussing using CodeX/Codex agents on predictive sports betting platform Predict.fun, reporting solid daily yields through automated, script-driven bets.

items.title: @Ripple: Stablecoin Volume Growth
items.body: Ripple and CoinDesk released a report showing stablecoin transaction volume reached $33 trillion in 2025, which exceeds global credit card volume, signaling major institutional migration.

items.title: @xuedingding01: Midea's EU Regulatory Arbitrage
items.body: Chinese appliance maker Midea successfully bypassed French environmental rules by using exactly 1.99kg of coolant in its AC units ( فرنسا requires inspection if >2kg) and designed self-installable units to avoid heavy Italian fines for DIY installations.

items.title: @WangNextDoor2: Vehicle Sales Registration Error Lawsuit
items.body: A dealership forgot to register a customer's $60,000 cash purchase and instead reported the vehicle stolen, leading to the buyer being jailed for a day. The victim is now suing the dealership and police department for $200,000.

items.title: @andresweiss_: Germany's World Cup Penalty Controversy
items.body: Following Germany's dramatic World Cup exit to Paraguay in a penalty shootout, midfielder Leon Goretzka is facing intense criticism. Reports indicate Goretzka twice refused captain Joshua Kimmich's requests to take the decisive 6th penalty, forcing center-back Jonathan Tah to take his first-ever career penalty, which was missed.

items.title: @abosalaharena: Norway's World Cup Catering Shortage
items.body: The Norwegian national team traveled to the World Cup with 300kg of fish and 180kg of Norwegian cheese under the assumption they wouldn't advance beyond the group stage. Following their surprise qualification, the federation had to rush-order emergency shipments of native food.

items.title: @caomei_nz: Japan Coach Moriyasu's Apology
items.body: After Japan's close World Cup knockout defeat to Brazil, head coach Hajime Moriyasu won praise for taking full personal responsibility, apologizing to fans for 'inadequate coaching,' and expressing pride in Japan's international football progress.

items.title: @ConnCFC: Bono's Spectacular Penalty Save
items.body: Morocco's goalkeeper Bono made a phenomenal save against Summerville's well-placed penalty kick to secure Morocco's victory and eliminate the Netherlands, sparking widespread acclaim as one of the best saves of the tournament.
